calls.reason: This is a conditional forecast, and nothing in the packet shows OpenAI failing to meet its obligations by the evaluation date. The April 2026 CNBC selloff followed a reported revenue miss, not a failure to pay.

Leaked figures reported by The Information put OpenAI's Q1 2026 operating loss at $9.3B. GitHub and Anthropic both changed pricing or limits because agent sessions cost far more to serve than flat plans bring in. OpenAI's improved gross margin softens but doesn't undo this.

Reuters reported seniority and downside protection for private equity backers, the joint venture closed with a 17.5% guaranteed annual return, and $35B of Amazon's commitment reportedly depends on an IPO or an AGI milestone. All three are unusual investor-friendly terms.

As of the August 2026 CNBC reports, OpenAI had filed confidentially but set no IPO date. It had not priced, withdrawn or repriced a listing, and its tender offer held flat at $852B, so the forecast is still open.
